# `McpServerFactory`

`Rasuvaeff\Yii3Mcp\McpServerFactory`

**Class** — [`Rasuvaeff\Yii3Mcp`](/packages/core) — [Source](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/yii3-mcp/blob/master/src/McpServerFactory.php)

Builds an SDK Server from a list of application tool classes.

Capability methods are declared with the SDK's own attributes (#[McpTool],
#[McpResource], #[McpResourceTemplate], #[McpPrompt]) on public methods;
handlers are registered as [class, method] references, so instances are
resolved lazily through the DI container and receive their dependencies
the normal Yii3 way. Classes implementing ConditionalToolInterface may opt
out of registration at build time.

## Methods

### create()

```php
create(
    array $toolClasses,
    iterable $configurators,
    iterable $interceptors,
    ?Visibility\ToolVisibilityInterface $toolVisibility,
    iterable $promptInterceptors,
    iterable $resourceInterceptors,
    ?Visibility\PromptVisibilityInterface $promptVisibility,
    ?Visibility\ResourceVisibilityInterface $resourceVisibility,
): Mcp\Server
```

- `$interceptors` — tool-call chain, first = outermost
- `$toolVisibility` — per-session filter for tools/list + fail-closed tools/call
- `$promptInterceptors` — prompts/get chain, first = outermost
- `$resourceInterceptors` — resources/read chain (static + templates), first = outermost
- `$promptVisibility` — per-session filter for prompts/list + fail-closed prompts/get
- `$resourceVisibility` — per-session filter for resources/list, resources/templates/list + fail-closed resources/read
